basic_profile.bio: An enthusiastic gaming newcomer from Dublin, Ireland, who's diving headfirst into the world of fighting games. When not battling in Dragon Ball FighterZ, I enjoy exploring the depths of Subnautica. A part-time barista by day and a gaming explorer by night, I usually spend my evenings online, especially during weekends. Currently single, I value time with friends and often turn to Reddit for advice and community interactions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Primarily self-taught in gaming through YouTube tutorials and online forums, with a keen interest in learning from community discussions. I recently picked up Dragon Ball FighterZ and am still learning the ropes of team composition and game mechanics.
